reviews.text: They were wonderful, the service was excellent, from the assistant to the doctor. Thank you so much! 💯 …
Thank you Dr. Margarida Vale for all the professionalism and care you give to all the animals that pass through your hands. Thank you, Dr.

I would like to praise and thank the excellent and prestigious Dr. Margarida Vale for the care and attention she provided to my cat Nala.

I also cannot forget to mention the very attentive receptionist. Many successes to both of you and thank you very much.

First of all, I want to highlight the competence, kindness, and courage shown by Dr. Margarida Vale when dealing with problematic dogs. I can only offer praise for her performance.
However, I cannot say the same about the clinic owner, who took advantage of a conversation I was having with the aforementioned doctor on December 23rd, when I was scheduling my dog's vaccination appointment. Let me explain: the individual overheard the conversation and saw an opportunity to extort money from clients with a "risk fee" that will surely go into his pocket and not to those who face the dogs' teeth.
Today, December 28th, upon arriving at the clinic, we were confronted with this extortion. We accepted it because the doctor is trustworthy thanks to her unquestionable professionalism, unlike the opportunists who languish and call themselves veterinarians.
Therefore, I recommend extreme caution to pet owners who seek out these establishments (the Telheiras clinic and the Bairro da Encarnação clinic). Inform yourselves well and look for alternatives so you don't get ripped off.
The 3-star rating is the average, as the doctor deserves 8 stars and the reviewer -8 stars.
I reiterate my congratulations to Dr. Margarida Vale.
A word of thanks, also, to the receptionist who performed her duties very well.
